categories.main_business_segments: Beijing E-techstar Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three segments: digital energy, communication technology services, and intelligent IoT application solutions. The digital energy segment focuses on integrating traditional power technologies with IoT, big data, 5G, and advanced communication technologies to provide smart energy solutions including virtual power plants. The communication technology services segment offers network planning, design, construction, and maintenance mainly for telecom operators and power sectors. The intelligent IoT applications segment develops solutions for smart cities, agriculture, meteorology, factories, and parks, leveraging a 1+N+M product system comprising a core platform, multiple platform products, and various solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced IoT big data technology, microservice architecture, and modular component design in its proprietary platforms such as the H-iTMG technology middle platform, H-ARIoT real-time monitoring platform, H-VBI visual business intelligence platform, and H-COP management information platform. It develops energy IoT big data application platforms with self-owned intellectual property, including virtual power plant trading and operation platforms, energy aggregator operation control platforms, and carbon emission big data management platforms. The company also integrates edge computing, industrial CPUs, broadband carrier chips, and data encryption chips in its solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major telecom operators such as China Mobile, China Unicom, China Telecom, and China Tower, as well as power grid enterprises like State Grid and Southern Power Grid. The company serves industries including energy, telecommunications, government, agriculture, and urban management. Its solutions target digital transformation needs in these sectors, with projects spanning smart energy management, communication network construction, and intelligent IoT applications for smart cities and agriculture.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with significant business in Northeast China, North China, South China, East China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest regions. It has offices and project presence in over 160 cities nationwide, including Beijing, Shenyang, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and others. Additionally, it has established subsidiaries abroad, including in the United Kingdom, expanding its international footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing E-techstar operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It provides technology development, system integration, design, engineering construction, and maintenance services, acting as a solutions provider and operator in digital energy and communication technology sectors. It also engages in energy aggregation and virtual power plant operations, positioning itself as both a technology enabler and service operator within the energy and telecom ecosystems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology leadership and innovation, focusing on developing a unified R&D platform and expanding its 1+N+M product system. Key R&D initiatives include industrial internet platform development, digital fusion technology for smart cities, virtual power plant trading and operation platforms, energy aggregator operation control platforms, and carbon emission big data management platforms. It invests heavily in R&D to enhance core competencies in digital energy, IoT big data, edge computing, and AI, aiming to support digital transformation in energy, telecom, and smart city sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through system integration contracts, software product sales, software development services, technical services, product sales, engineering construction and maintenance, property management, and training services. The company recognizes revenue based on contract fulfillment, product delivery, and service provision, with a mix of project-based and recurring service income. It also earns revenue from leasing and energy-related operational services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic provider in digital energy, communication technology services, and intelligent IoT solutions. Its subsidiary, Liaoning Postal Planning and Design Institute, holds top-tier industry qualifications and is among the few with comprehensive design and consulting capabilities in communication and energy sectors. The company competes with telecom network service providers and design institutes affiliated with telecom operators, leveraging its broad qualifications, technical expertise, and extensive client base to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.11 billion, a 17.3% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 992 million, primarily due to intensified industry competition, cost increases, project delays, and significant goodwill impairment of RMB 505.8 million. Total assets stood at RMB 3.61 billion, down 21.7% year-over-year, with net assets of RMB 1.41 billion, down 41.6%. The company has experienced a challenging growth trajectory with negative profitability in the latest fiscal year but maintains a substantial asset base and ongoing R&D investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its comprehensive digital energy solutions integrating IoT, big data, 5G, and advanced communication technologies, enabling smart energy systems like virtual power plants with nationwide deployment. Its proprietary 1+N+M product system and unified R&D platform provide scalable, modular, and customizable solutions across energy, telecom, and smart city applications. Strong industry qualifications, extensive project experience with major state grid and telecom clients, and a broad patent portfolio underpin its technological leadership and customer trust, delivering integrated digital transformation capabilities that enhance operational efficiency and sustainability for clients.
